projects.taktix.description.message: Coaches often still plan training and matchdays with paper notes and chat groups. Taktix is my own backend application that brings squad management, training planning, matchday preparation and line-ups together in six modules and reduces the organizational effort. Currently in beta, tested with real coaches.

projects.taktix.imageLabel.message: Screenshot of the Taktix login page in front of a tactics board in the locker room

projects.conduit.description.message: Manual deployments are error-prone and slow. I built a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and the GitHub Container Registry that builds the application, prepares the configuration and deploys it to the server via SSH. Result: a fully automated path from push to production in three stages.

projects.conduit.imageLabel.message: Preview of the Conduit Container project

projects.juice.description.message: You only really understand security flaws once you exploit them yourself. In the OWASP Juice Shop I reproduced and documented attacks such as SQL injection and authentication flaws. Result: write-ups that show how the flaws work and how to prevent them.

projects.juice.imageLabel.message: Preview of the Juice Shop Master project

projects.babytools.description.message: A shop for baby and kids products should keep its data even after a restart. I built a full-stack application with Python and Django that runs on SQLite and is operated through a custom Docker setup with volume mapping. Result: a dockerized shop with persistent data.

projects.babytools.imageLabel.message: Preview of the Baby Tools Shop project

projects.wordpress.description.message: A self-hosted WordPress server should run reproducibly and securely. I set it up with Docker Compose, MySQL and phpMyAdmin, put the data into volumes and moved all credentials into a .env file. Result: a blog that stays online through a restart policy, with no secrets in the repo.

projects.wordpress.imageLabel.message: Preview of the WordPress server project

projects.minecraft.description.message: A Java server should be set up and started without manual steps. I containerized it with a custom Dockerfile on an OpenJDK base image and wrote an entrypoint script that automates provisioning, configuration and startup. Result: a server that runs with a single command.

projects.minecraft.imageLabel.message: Preview of the Minecraft Server project

about.p1.message: Alongside my service in the Bundeswehr I completed IT training in my spare time. What drives me is to keep expanding my knowledge and to continuously improve the quality of my work.

about.p2.message: My path began in 2025 with an e-training as a Data Analyst (Python); in 2026 I took the Python Fundamentals course at Technische Akademie Nord. I then completed the training as a software developer with a back-end focus at Developer Akademie: 13 modules and four capstone projects, including Coderr and Quizzly.

about.p3.message: I am currently doing the DevSecOps Engineer training, which I complete in October 2026. There I am deepening CI/CD with GitHub Actions, container orchestration, IT security and Linux infrastructure.

contact.intro.message: Here is what I'm looking for and what I bring:

contact.role.message: Role: I'm looking for a position as a Junior DevSecOps Engineer or Backend Developer, and I'm also open to a dual study program in computer science.

contact.contribution.message: Contribution: After 9 years in the Bundeswehr as a Feldwebel, I bring leadership, reliability and a calm head under pressure, combined with hands-on skills in Docker, CI/CD, Linux and Python.

contact.remote.message: Remote: I'm looking for on-site or hybrid roles in the Hamburg/Bremen area and I'm open to remote work anywhere in Germany.

contact.lookingForward.message: Looking forward to hearing from you!

hero.bio.message: From automotive mechatronics technician and Feldwebel to backend developer with a focus on DevSecOps. I build Django APIs, containerize them with Docker and automate builds and deployments with CI/CD.

projects.coderr.description.message: Coderr is a platform where providers create offers and customers can book them. I built the backend with Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including user management, authentication and a PostgreSQL database.

projects.quizzly.description.message: With Quizly you turn YouTube videos into interactive quizzes: the app analyzes the video with AI and automatically creates 10 questions. I built the backend with Python, Django and Django REST Framework, with JWT authentication and integration of language models (LLMs).
